डप्: † डप् डप्, i. 10, डापय, Ātm. To collect.
डम्: डम् डम्, i. 1 or 6. Par. To sound, Prab. 55, 6.
डमरिन्: डमरिन् डमरिन् and डमरु ड-मरु, m. A kind of drum, Bhāg. P. 8, 10, 7; Prab. 55, 6.
डम्प्: † डम्प् डम्प्, v. r. for डप्।
डम्ब्: डम्ब् डम्ब्, i. 10, Par. To cast.  -- With the prep. वि वि,  1. To imitate, Ragh. 4, 17.  2. To simulate, Hariv. 8406.  3. To deride, to sneer, Hariv. 1.  4. To deceive, Bhartṛ. 1, 21. विडम्-बित, Low, poor, distressed.
डम्बर: डम्बर डम्बर,  I. adj.  1. Re-nowned, Mālat. 3, 8, Lass. वाच्-m. Graceful and eloquent language.  II. m.  1. A proper name, MBh. 9, 2541.  2. A mass, assemblage (as of blossoms), Mālat. 48, last 1., 148, 8; (of clouds), Mahāvīr. 99, 17; Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 37.
डम्भ्: डम्भ् डम्भ्, v. r. of डप्।
डाकिनी: डाकिनी डाकिनी (probably a form of शाकिनी), f. A kind of female demon, Kathās. 18, 147.
डाकिनीत्व: डाकिनीत्व डाकिनी + त्व, n. The character of a Ḍākinī, Daśak. 164, 17.
डांकृति: डांकृति डांकृति, i. e. डाम्, an imi-tative sound, -कृति, f. Sound, Prab. 55, 6. -- Cf. तांकृत।
डामर: डामर डामर,  1. m. An object causing surprise, Gīt. 12, 23.  2. The name of a people, Rājat. 5, 51.
डिण्डिम: डिण्डिम डिण्डिम, m. A kind of drum, Rām. 5, 13, 49.
डिप्: † डिप् डिप्, डिम्प् डिम्प्, i, 10, Ātm. To collect. डिप् डिप्, i. 4; 6 and 10, Par., and डिम्ब् डिम्ब्, i. 10, Ātm. To cast.
डिम्ब: डिम्ब डिम्ब, m.  1. An affray, con-flict, MBh. 1, 1219; a battle without king, i. e. after the king has been slain (?), Man. 5, 95.  2. An egg or ball, Mālat. 148, 8.
डिम्भ्: † डिम्भ् डिम्भ्, i, 10, Ātm. To collect.
डिम्भ: डिम्भ डिम्भ, m. and f. भा, A child, Śāk. p. 103, 11 (Prākṛ.).
डी: डी डी (akin to 1. दी, q. cf.), i. 1 and 4, Ātm. To fly. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. डिन, n. Flying, the flight of a bird, MBh. 8, 1899. -- With the prep. अति अति, अतिडीन, n. Flying over, MBh. 8, 1900. -- With अभि अभि, अभिडीन, n. Flying towards, MBh. 8, 1900. -- With अव अव, अवडीन, n. Flying down, MBh. 8, 1899. -- With उद् उद्, To fly up, Pañc. 106, 1. उड्डीन, Flown up, MBh. 7, 776. n.  1. Flying up, MBh. 8, 1899.  2. The flight of a bird, Pañc. 114, 25. -- With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, To fly up and away, Mṛcch. 84, 22. प्रोड्डीन, Flown up and away, Rām. 4, 63, 24. --With नि नि, निडीन, n. Flying down, MBh. 8, 1899. -- With परा परा, परा-डीन, n. Flying away, MBh. 8, 1900. --With परि परि, परिडीन, n. Flying round, MBh. 8, 1900. -- With प्र प्र, प्रडीन, Flown forth, Rām. 6, 83, 26; n. Flying forward, MBh. 8, 1899. -- With वि वि, विडीन, n. Flying apart, MBh. 8, 1900. -- With सम् सम्, संडीन, n. Flying together, MBh. 8, 1899. -- With अवसम् अव-सम्, अवसंदीन, n. Fly-ing down together, MBh. 8, 1901.
डीनक: डीनक डीन + क (vb. डी) in डीन -डीनक, A kind of flying, MBh. 8, 1900.
डुण्डुभ: डुण्डुभ डुण्डुभ, m. A kind of lizard, Amphisbæna, MBh. 1, 984. --Cf. दुण्डुभ।
डोम्ब: डोम्ब डोम्ब, m. A man of a low caste, who gains his livelihood by singing and dancing, Rājat. 5, 353.
डौण्डुभ: डौण्डुभ डौण्डुभ, i. e. डुण्डुभ + अ, n. The body of a ḍuṇḍubha, MBh. 1, 1006.
ड्वल्: ड्वल् ड्वल्, Caus. ड्वालय, with the prep. आ आ, To mix (ved.).
